wiki.title: Renee Erickson (politician)
wiki.extract: Renee Kendra Erickson (born May 23, 1964) is an American school principal and politician from the state of Kansas. A Republican, Erickson represented the 87th district of the Kansas House of Representatives, based in eastern Wichita, from 2019 to 2020. In 2020, she successfully ran for the Kansas Senate, where she represents the 30th Senate district for a term ending in 2024.
